Name: Builder Assistant 建筑助手
Description: Android-first Builder Assistant. v0.6 keeps the independent speedboat prototype (behavior unchanged) and the offline auto-building cottage foundation, and tackles the 'target chunk not loaded or out of bounds' failure: the build planner now classifies each non-editable cell (height out of range / beyond valid bounds / terrain not ready / chunk missing / chunk state not ready / chunk not loaded), the runtime can wait a bounded number of frames for chunks to load before writing, and rollback/undo now track and retry deferred cells instead of silently reporting a clean finish. Verified so far by offline Core+Generators logic tests (72/72); the game-adapter layer and Android single-player behavior are still 待验证 (pending real-device verification).
Author: godblessmezyan-art
